description: Purpose of this region: knowledge about the PWNC Desktop (pwnc/module/desktop.php) learned from working with it.
content:
This region collects what has been learned about the Desktop — communication (mail, messaging, contacts, object exchange), planning (calendar, notes) and links.

Belongs here: how a Desktop application behaves in practice, how messages and objects are exchanged, and traps found along the way.

Does not belong here: what the shipped manuals already document, or the content of conversations — that belongs with the people and topics it concerns (the scope.org_* regions).
